variant.author: LatencyBryer
variant.changelog:
### **Added:**
- Maintenance reminders now auto-create alarms
- Chat time conversion now detect time formats using symbols

### **Improved:**
- Maintenance reminders now uses the start time
- Maintenance checks run automatically every 2 hours

### **Notes:**
- Old **24 hours** maintenance reminder option was replaced for **5 hours before**
variant.description:
Use this to know the current time in different timezones in a customizable way.
You can change the text scale, colors, position and even setup Alarms!
variant.name: Clock
variant.punchline: Tired of missing stuff cause everything is in another timezone? Say less.
